content: llms.txt adoption is mainstream in component libraries by 2026: Nuxt UI, Ant Design, MUI, React Aria, Svelte, Next.js ship llms.txt at site root. Markdown ~6x more token-efficient than HTML. Cursor/Claude Code/Copilot consume it. Mantine goes further with @mantine/mcp-server and LLM docs regenerated per release. Shipping llms.txt at v0.1.0 is an early-mover differentiator for smaller libraries; MCP server is the next tier (fase 2).
